data.name: Doug
data.long_meaning: The name Doug is of Old English origin, derived from the term 'dūg,' meaning 'dark' or 'stranger'. The name was commonly used in Scotland and Ireland. In the Middle Ages, it was also given to the sons of Viking warriors, reflecting the Norse influence in Scotland and Ireland.
